Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço). Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio. Principais Responsabilidades  Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade. Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão. Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções. Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis. Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados. Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema. Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança. Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.  Requisitos Necessários  Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação. Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost. Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares). Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas. Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção. Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.  Diferenciais  Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes. Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares. Experiência em varejo. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.  #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

Conteúdo é um dos motores desse crescimento. Cada corte que sai da nossa edição educa pacientes, quebra tabus sobre disfunções íntimas e mostra que existe tratamento sério para problemas que a maioria dos lugares trata errado. Agora estamos abrindo vaga para um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior que queira entrar nesse time, aprender rápido e crescer junto. Cargo Júnior. Mas não é uma vaga para quem quer ficar Júnior. Quem entrega, evolui rápido para Pleno — esse é o nosso jeito de operar em todos os cargos. A vaga em uma frase Assistir vídeos longos da PelvClinic, achar os melhores trechos e transformar em cortes curtos que prendem atenção no Reels, TikTok e Shorts. A edição técnica importa. Mas escolher o corte certo importa mais. Saber identificar qual trecho começa forte, qual fala gera curiosidade, qual explicação tem valor — esse é o olhar que faz a diferença entre um editor comum e um editor que move o ponteiro. É isso que vamos te ensinar e cobrar. Como você vai trabalhar Você será liderado(a) pela Emilly, nossa Social Media, que vai te orientar no dia a dia: demanda, feedback, padrão de qualidade, prioridades. Trabalho remoto exige maturidade. Você precisa ter: • Computador próprio com capacidade real para edição • Boa internet • Organização para entregar sem ser lembrado • Disponibilidade para alinhamentos com a Emilly Se você precisa de cobrança constante para produzir, essa vaga não é pra você. O que estamos buscando Três coisas — em ordem de importância: 1. Olho para conteúdo. Capacidade de assistir uma hora de vídeo e identificar os 30 segundos que prendem atenção sozinhos. 2. Constância. Entregar bem hoje, amanhã e na semana que vem. Não picos seguidos de sumiço. 3. Vontade real de crescer. Pessoa que estuda referência por conta própria, aceita feedback sem peso, aplica e volta melhor. >>>Teste prático (Passo 1) Vídeo de explicação do teste:  A sua pontuação no teste terá base na qualidade e quantidade de bons cortes e conteúdos que conseguir extrair de cada vídeo longo: • Vídeos curtos de alcance em formato 16:9 (geralmente de 20 segundos até 2 minutos — topo de funil) • Vídeos médios de 2 a 7 minutos formato 16:9, mais completos e explicados, para gerar mais profundidade de relacionamento (meio e fundo de funil) • Carrosséis, tanto dos vídeos longos base, quanto dos vídeos menores FAQ: tem número de vídeos que vocês imaginam? O teste é para ver a sua capacidade de extrair o maior número de bons conteúdos e ideias possível de cada vídeo longo (vídeos menores e posts/carrosséis). P.S. Os vídeos já foram editados por nós, e essa será a régua para classificação. Vídeos longos base (extrair vídeos curtos e carrosséis): Vídeo 1:  Vídeo 2:  Quanto maior o número e a qualidade dos conteúdos, mais alta sua pontuação. Penalização por conteúdos ruins ou fracos. Sem encher linguiça — o que conta é volume de conteúdos bons. Critérios de avaliação: • Seleção de tema e clareza da ideia • Título / Headline escrito • Gancho falado — força nos 0–3s e 0–7s, curiosidade e interesse sem clickbait • Entrega de conteúdo — satisfação depois de consumir • Comunicação da marca — ética, acolhimento, evidência, linguagem simples • Velocidade e capricho — quanto mais rápido melhor, arquivos nomeados, zero ruído Referências de vídeos curtos:         >>>Como se candidatar (por e-mail) Envie o teste feito para:  •   •   Assunto: Vaga Editor de Vídeo Júnior — (Seu Nome)  Corpo: ENVIE o Link (pasta no drive) dos conteúdos que você editou + currículo  Para quem essa vaga não é  • Quem quer trabalho remoto pra ficar tranquilo • Quem precisa de cobrança constante pra entregar • Quem reage a feedback como ataque • Quem quer fazer o mínimo e receber o suficiente Para quem essa vaga é  • Quem está começando mas quer crescer rápido • Quem topa trabalhar duro para se provar • Quem quer entrar numa empresa que está construindo algo grande e ter a chance de crescer junto

You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well. We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed. Key Responsibilities  Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business. Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms. Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue.  Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library.  Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early. Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.  What You Bring  Experience & Qualifications Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams. 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus) Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements. Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment. Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements.  Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.   Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.  Why Join Us   Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies. IMPORTANT  Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. Compensation:  $40-60/hour depending on experience

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends. ResponsibilitiesThe selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity DifferentAt IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred QualificationsWe are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Headshots Retoucher
description:
Empresa está contratando Headshots Retoucher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job description:  About Us  Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology. Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. We are hiring experienced headshot retouchers for ongoing work who can handle high volume while maintaining realism, accuracy, and professional polish. Role Overview  This role focuses on high-quality retouching of professional headshots sourced from mobile phone photos. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches. Following a brief unpaid test project, selected candidates will invited for an interview, with the opportunity for long-term, steady work. Core Responsibilities  Image Retouching & Quality Control  Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images  Production & Workflow Discipline  Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards Apply feedback consistently and efficiently Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality  Core Skills Required  Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look) Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos) Realistic background compositing Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light Excellent time management and consistency at scale Strong written English (spoken English for occasional Zoom calls is a plus)  Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)  Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, or similar) Legitimate Adobe Photoshop subscription (no cracked software) MacBook Pro Retina or equivalent high-quality PC laptop display Monitor accurate in sRGB (DCI-P3 support is a plus)  Volume, Timing & Pay  $5 USD per image Expected volume after trial period: 100+ images/month, with potential to scale higher The $2,000/month reference rate is based on completing approximately 20 headshots per day across 20 working days  Application Requirements (Read Carefully)  Apply by completing the test project:   Hiring Process  Applicants are asked to complete a brief unpaid test project Successful test submissions will be invited to interview Ongoing, consistent work available for high-performing retouchers Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. All applications must be submitted through Indeed. Job Types: Full-time, Contract  IMPORTANT  All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. O projeto está inserido em um contexto estratégico, com atuação próxima às áreas de negócio e tecnologia, envolvendo iniciativas que exigem visão de produto, organização de demandas, capacidade de priorização e condução de times em ambientes ágeis e corporativos complexos. entregas Criar, detalhar e priorizar itens do Product Backlog  garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio Traduzir necessidades e demandas em requisitos claros, estruturados e acionáveis para de backlog Experiência na interface entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia Habilidade para conduzir alinhamentos com múltiplos stakeholders em ambientes corporativos complexos Experiência com escrita de user stories , refinamento funcional e definição de critérios de aceite Capacidade de apoiar a organização e fluidez dos ritos ágeis do time   Será um destaque seu perfil com:  Inglês avançado  para interação em ambientes corporativos e alinhamentos com diferentes stakeholders Experiência prévia em projetos ou ambientes SAP  Certificações ágeis como CSPO, PSPO, CSM  ou similares Perfil digital e evolução de processos corporativos Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua   Onde você vai trabalhar? Job Description  A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA  experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success. Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys. Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution. THE ROLE  The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO  Learning Lab Architecture & Management  Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.  System Administration & Support  Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management  Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.  Reporting & Documentation  Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.  WHAT IT TAKES  Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.  Be fully aligned to our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust  in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.  Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead  to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm : a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do  Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution.  On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod.  Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed.  You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle.  You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are  You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if  You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if  You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location  Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. How to apply  To apply, please email  (not DM) the following directly to   and copy  :  Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned  In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery  We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

description:
Confira a oportunidade para Supervisor de Hardware em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.  Responsabilidades   Participar da definição e implementação de soluções tecnológicas, contribuindo com novas ideias e sugestões para novos produtos, novas funcionalidades e atualizações de produtos existentes, em nível de componentes, esquemas elétricos, bem como nos processos e ferramentas de desenvolvimento.  Definir ou participar da definição de conceitos e especificações técnicas de novos produtos e atualizações dos existentes, contribuindo com informações para apoiar a tomada de decisão e análises de viabilidade relacionadas a risco, prazo, custo e qualidade.  Desenvolver hardware para novas implementações ou modificações em produtos existentes, atendendo aos objetivos de prazo, custo e qualidade dos projetos ou atividades.  Pesquisar, sugerir e definir componentes eletrônicos a serem utilizados nos produtos, bem como sugerir e/ou definir arquiteturas e circuitos integrados para os projetos, em conjunto com a equipe de hardware, buscando sempre a solução mais adequada considerando custo, desempenho e tecnologia.  Acompanhar atividades de certificação e testes de produtos, analisar falhas identificadas e sugerir e/ou implementar ações corretivas, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua e redução de falhas e tempo de desenvolvimento.  Monitorar continuamente o mercado de componentes eletrônicos e produtos finais, mantendo-se atualizado sobre novos lançamentos, soluções e tecnologias que possam ser aplicáveis ou representar riscos para o negócio da empresa.    Responsabilidades do Coordenador de Hardware   Gerenciar a estrutura e qualificação da equipe.  Garantir que as tecnologias utilizadas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos aprovados pela empresa.  Estabelecer metodologias e processos, além de acompanhar e gerenciar as atividades em andamento, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade das entregas.  Participar, quando solicitado, de projetos de inovação tecnológica, lançamentos de novas linhas ou mix de produtos, bem como de atividades de teste, como produção piloto.  Manter-se atualizado por meio da participação em cursos, seminários e outras atividades de desenvolvimento profissional, visando melhoria contínua e acompanhamento das inovações tecnológicas.    Responsabilidades Gerais   Zelar por um ambiente de trabalho positivo, incentivando a participação e contribuição de todos para otimização dos resultados.  Cumprir normas, instruções e procedimentos internos relacionados à qualidade, meio ambiente, requisitos de clientes, saúde e segurança do trabalho, medicina preventiva, entre outros; seguir as diretrizes e participar de treinamentos, visando ações preventivas e boas condições de trabalho.  Seguir as políticas da Stoneridge quanto à conduta, conforme o Código de Conduta e Políticas Globais.  Executar outras atividades profissionais correlatas ao cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.    Formação   Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Mecatrônica, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.    Experiência   Experiência desejada de 10 anos na função ou em cargo similar, com atuação em:  Desenvolvimento de produtos;  Desenvolvimento de hardware e eletrônica embarcada.         #J-18808-Ljbffr
